analysis_summary: Special episode featuring Anders Borg (former Swedish Finance Minister 2006-2014, now board member at LKAB, Stena, advisor to Kinnevik). Main thesis: 2026 is a 'risk-on year' with US economy strong at 2-3% growth driven by AI/productivity. Bullish on both US and European equities, with Europe offering value opportunity in depressed sectors. Discusses Europe's structural problems (lack of capital markets, funded pensions, VC ecosystem) vs Nordic strengths. Highlights India as major 20-year opportunity and China's surprising AI competitiveness via DeepSeek.
